stages.name: generate
stages.instruction: For each seed topic, create ONE self-contained Python security/edge-case coding task as JSON array: [{"id": "<seed_id>", "title": "...", "buggy_code": "...", "fixed_code": "...", "test_code": "...assert..."}]. The test_code MUST fail on buggy_code and pass on fixed_code using Python stdlib only.

stages.name: exec-verify-gate
stages.command:
python3 -c 'import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib; inp, outp = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]; kept = []
for ln in pathlib.Path(inp).read_text().splitlines():
    if not ln.strip(): continue
    it = json.loads(ln)
    if not all(k in it for k in ("buggy_code","fixed_code","test_code")): continue
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        p = pathlib.Path(td)
        (p/"sol.py").write_text(it["buggy_code"]+"\n"+it["test_code"])
        r_bug = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(p/"sol.py")], capture_output=True, timeout=5)
        (p/"sol.py").write_text(it["fixed_code"]+"\n"+it["test_code"])
        r_fix = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(p/"sol.py")], capture_output=True, timeout=5)
        if r_bug.returncode != 0 and r_fix.returncode == 0:
            it["exec_verified"] = True; kept.append(it)
pathlib.Path(outp).write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(x) for x in kept) + ("\n" if kept else ""))
print(f"admitted {len(kept)}")' {in_jsonl} {out_jsonl}
